headline: Tufa Labs extends ARC-AGI-2 lead to 88.06

sections.text: Tufa Labs added 4.45 points to reach 88.06 and remains first on the ARC-AGI-2 public board, 7.50 ahead of rabbithole at 80.56.

ARC Prize announced a $150,000 bonus pool for qualifying teams. Jean-François Puget asked whether that threshold applies to the public or private leaderboard; no organizer answer was visible in the checked thread.

sources.title: ARC-AGI-2 public leaderboard: saved board and the past day's changes
